note: Both sets are accurate on the claims they share, but B captures two important facts A omits: the single-DOF design model of the blade-pitch controller and the conditional torque logic (Region-3 torque computation whenever the previous blade-pitch command was 1° or greater). B's only flaw is that it states the gain-scheduled PI control method twice, under 'blade-pitch controller' and 'blade-pitch control system'. A is clean but incomplete, so B is the better set overall.
remarks: B repeats the gain-scheduled PI control-method claim under two entity names ('blade-pitch controller' and 'blade-pitch control system'); deduplicating would make B clearly stronger. Both sets leave out the stated purpose of the Region-3 torque override (improved output power quality at the expense of short-term generator/gearbox overloading) and the 10%-above-rated saturation rationale, though the saturation value itself is captured.
